title: Bind AI control-plane kernels onto PE campaign transitions
objective: Bind the AI coding control-plane kernels, Gold Nugget Extractor, Diagnose First, Preflight 2, and harvested wiring taxonomy onto existing make-campaign transitions so the runner refuses stub seeds, verifies with honest PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE including wiring, repairs on the same task, and completes only on Definition of Done — without a second front door, new runner stage, or kernel YAML dumps.
success_criteria: A seed whose actions are implement_task_00n, whose acceptance is the title-plus-locally-verified stub, or whose ready tasks lack nugget_id, consumers, entrypoints, or validation[] is refused before source-integrity-receipt.json is written
plan_status outside {Ready, ConditionallyReady} leaves CAMPAIGN_SOURCE.yaml unsealed and compile_activation exits nonzero
pec verify_attempt writes kernel_verdict PASS|FAIL|INCOMPLETE on the verification receipt; missing validation command is INCOMPLETE not PASS; inspection file presence is not a runtime PASS
CHANGE re-entry runs only when kernel_verdict is FAIL on the same task_id; INCOMPLETE does not enter CHANGE; Diagnose First refuses mutate-before-diagnosis and requires revalidate-before-execution
evaluate-gate plus pec complete_task require the seven PE-mandatory DoD gates; PASSED_LOCAL alone does not complete a task
Rendered Contract carries kernel_profile in {BUILD, CHANGE, AUDIT}; task authorization_ceiling.merge and deploy_or_migrate stay false

nuggets.json exists at $HOME/.l9/primed/<id>/nuggets.json; every ready task has nugget_id; tool or stack nuggets cite stack-proof.json; campaign dir still contains only CAMPAIGN_SOURCE.yaml and source-integrity-receipt.json
UNTIL_STAGES remains activate blueprint admit bootstrap arm execute pr close; no eighth l9-ci-core reusable workflow; make pr-check PASS on the Cursor-Governance factory branch
